current.summary: Version 5 complete marketing foundation: planning, media, approval, ideas, leads, reviews, segments, campaigns, follow-ups and reporting.
changes: Started Version 5 from the stable 4.3 baseline with protected rollback checkpoints
Content Calendar: month, week and day views with platform and workflow filtering
Content / Media Library: photos, videos, graphics, logos, folders, search and post attachments
Content Approval: Idea → Draft → Review → Approved → Scheduled → Published workflow with approval history
Content Ideas: idea bank, priorities, conversion to posts and existing campaign workflow
Google Review Management: review opportunities, request status and received/declined tracking
Social Enquiries / Leads: source tracking and New → Contacted → Quoted → Interested → Converted/Lost pipeline
Customer Segments: reusable marketing segments for repair, laptop, gaming, phone and previous customers
Campaigns: promotional campaign management and links between campaigns, posts and leads
Follow-up Campaigns: reusable follow-up templates for previous customers, reviews and promotions
Social Analytics: reach, engagement, platform and post-performance reporting already available in the CRM analytics layer
Monthly Marketing Reports: monthly performance records with enquiries, customers and attributed revenue
Marketing workspace: centralised leads, reviews, segments, follow-ups and reports without duplicating the repair CRM
Meta/Facebook/Instagram publishing intentionally deferred until Monday as requested
